extracted.intended_audience: students, researchers, and general readers seeking a reference overview of United Nations and related international organizations
extracted.subtask_description: A factual reference listing UN organs, specialized agencies, and related international organizations with their establishment dates, stated aims, membership composition, and related notes. Useful for compiling encyclopedia-style entries or background summaries of international institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization name / title
rubrics_metrics.description: The full official name of the organization (e.g., United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF), World Health Organization (WHO)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include common acronyms in parentheses immediately after the name; retain acronyms that are historically or commonly used (note: 'acronym retained from the predecessor organization' appears as guidance in the text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Established date
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear statement of when the organization was established (e.g., 'established - 11 December 1946').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When relevant, also include an 'effective' date if the organization became operational later (e.g., 'established - 16 November 1945; effective - 4 November 1946').

rubrics_metrics.name: Aim / purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise statement of the organization's primary aim or mandate (e.g., 'aim - to promote cooperation in education, science, and culture').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the aim in plain language summarizing the primary function or mission of the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership (count and list)
rubrics_metrics.description: The number of members followed by a list of member states or entities (e.g., 'members - (192) all UN members plus Holy See' or long enumerated lists of countries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both the numeric count and the explicit list where available; note special cases such as 'all UN members are represented in the General Assembly' or where certain territories/associates are named separately (e.g., 'Cook Islands', 'Niue').

rubrics_metrics.name: Associate members
rubrics_metrics.description: Where applicable, an explicit list or count of associate members distinct from full members (e.g., 'associate members - (6) Aruba, British Virgin Islands, ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List associate members and indicate the relationship to full membership when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Observers
rubrics_metrics.description: Entities listed as observers to the organization (e.g., 'observers - (1 plus the Palestine Liberation Organization) Holy See, Palestine Liberation Organization').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate observer status and any special qualifiers or counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governing boards / executive bodies / commissioners
rubrics_metrics.description: Where present, identify the governing board or executive organ and its composition (e.g., 'members (executive board) - (36) selected on a rotating basis from all regions'; 'commissioners - (15) Argentina, Brazil, ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the name of the governing body, the number of seats, and selection method or regional composition when given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection method / regional rotation
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of how members of a board or committee are chosen (e.g., 'selected on a rotating basis from all regions'; 'elected for two-year terms by the UN General Assembly').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note terms, election/selection procedures, and regional representation rules where the entry provides them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special notes / historical remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary notes about name changes, predecessor organizations, suspended operations, or unique legal/administrative status (e.g., 'note - acronym retained from the predecessor organization, UN International Children's Emergency Fund'; 'Trusteeship Council (inactive; no trusteeships at this time)'; 'note - formerly known as ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include any explanatory remarks that clarify anomalies, historical changes, or exceptional statuses of the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandate / specific mission statements for operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific operational mandates for missions or peacekeeping forces (e.g., 'aim - to observe the 1973 Arab-Israeli cease-fire'; 'to supervise the 1948 Arab-Israeli cease-fire'; 'to monitor the demilitarized zone').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For mission-style entries (UNMIK, UNIFIL, MINURSO, etc.), explicitly record the operational mandate and whether it was established by the Security Council.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandate termination / status of mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Where applicable, notes that a mission or body's mandate ended or that an entity was terminated (e.g., 'mandate ended 6 October 2003'; 'was terminated 31 December 2002'; 'formally suspended operations 1 November 1995').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record termination dates and brief reason/context when provided in the entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliations and institutional relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements about affiliation with the UN or other bodies (e.g., 'affiliated with the UN 15 November 1947'; 'a UN specialized agency'; 'an ECOSOC organization').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note the type of relationship (specialized agency, ECOSOC organization, affiliated) and any implications for membership or governance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic/regional membership distinctions
rubrics_metrics.description: When the entry delineates regional or regional-block members or regional institutions (e.g., WAEMU members, 'regional members' vs 'international/nonregional members' for WADB).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture whether membership is regional, nonregional, institutional, or national and list examples as given.
